title: 20.8 — Try This (Final)
summary: Read the debate. Look up recent articles about AGI timelines. For each prediction you find, ask: What's their definition of AGI? What evidence do they cite? What's their incentive? (CEOs of AI companies have commercial incentives to hype; critics may have incentives to downplay.) Does their prediction survive Chapter 20's framework? Apply what you've learned. Read any AI news story and identify which chapters of this book it touches.…
